page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated physical cores with 16 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of one thread per core. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For accelerated workloads, the server includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring users to attach external block storage for operating systems and data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile balances dedicated compute resources and a dedicated GPU accelerator, though the lack of bundled local storage and a moderate network baseline are key architectural tradeoffs to consider when designing deployments.

The combination of dedicated CPU cores, 64.0 GB of RAM, and an NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance suitable for GPU-accelerated workloads. Appropriate use cases include entry-level machine learning inference, video transcoding, media processing, and parallel computing tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration without requiring massive local storage arrays.
